snapshot.name: players
snapshot.sql: SELECT p.id, p.full_name, p.nickname, p.avatar_ref, p.avatar_previous_ref, p.banner_id, p.profile_visibility, p.profile_state, p.hide_phone_from_clubs, p.hidden_from_directory, p.show_profile_stats, p.show_weekly_performance, p.experience_months, p.experience_recorded_at, p.personal_details, p.details_version, p.verification_override, p.verification_override_by, p.verification_override_at, p.revision::text AS revision, p.created_at, p.updated_at, c.phone_e164 AS contact_phone FROM players p LEFT JOIN player_private_contacts c ON c.player_id = p.id ORDER BY c.phone_e164 NULLS LAST, p.id

snapshot.name: player_private_contacts
snapshot.sql: SELECT c.*, p.full_name FROM player_private_contacts c JOIN players p ON p.id = c.player_id ORDER BY c.phone_e164

snapshot.name: player_id_allocations
snapshot.sql: SELECT a.*, c.phone_e164 AS contact_phone FROM player_id_allocations a LEFT JOIN player_private_contacts c ON c.player_id = a.player_id ORDER BY c.phone_e164 NULLS LAST, a.rtr_id

snapshot.name: player_id_counters
snapshot.sql: SELECT * FROM player_id_counters ORDER BY location_code_id, sync_date

snapshot.name: player_accounts
snapshot.sql: SELECT a.*, c.phone_e164 AS contact_phone FROM player_accounts a LEFT JOIN player_private_contacts c ON c.player_id = a.player_id ORDER BY c.phone_e164 NULLS LAST, a.player_id

snapshot.name: player_claim_links
snapshot.sql: SELECT l.*, c.phone_e164 AS contact_phone FROM player_claim_links l LEFT JOIN player_private_contacts c ON c.player_id = l.player_id ORDER BY l.token_digest

snapshot.name: club_players
snapshot.sql: SELECT cp.*, c.phone_e164 AS contact_phone FROM club_players cp LEFT JOIN player_private_contacts c ON c.player_id = cp.player_id ORDER BY cp.club_id, cp.display_name, cp.added_at, cp.id

snapshot.name: club_player_private_inputs
snapshot.sql: SELECT * FROM club_player_private_inputs ORDER BY club_player_id

snapshot.name: shared_player_entries
snapshot.sql: SELECT * FROM shared_player_entries ORDER BY rtr_id

snapshot.name: player_social_links
snapshot.sql: SELECT s.*, c.phone_e164 AS contact_phone FROM player_social_links s LEFT JOIN player_private_contacts c ON c.player_id = s.player_id ORDER BY c.phone_e164 NULLS LAST, s.player_id, s.provider

snapshot.name: player_notifications
